messages:
ana: PRD intake — ClearSight asked for per-tenant rollout gates tied to their OKRs. Problem: they want automatic rollback when tenant-quality drops. Need scope + success metrics. Can we scope a pilot?
jordan: Context: they see 15-20% variance after release in their domain. They care about OKR alignment: uptime + quality.
sam: Design ask: need a simple UI for tenant owners to see status and trigger overrides. Mockups later but want toggle + reason log. :eyes:
matt: Engineering note: runtime supports fallbacks and model variants, but per-tenant thresholds require per-tenant eval windows, storage for reference prompt sets, and an evaluation pipeline. Rough estimate: 3-4 sprints for MVP.
leah: Edge cases: tiny tenants with low traffic -> noisy metrics. Recommend min sample size + probation window. Also consider tenants that intentionally have different quality baselines.
sam: Non-goals: not doing baskets of custom models per tenant in pilot. Keep model surface same, use rollback to a safe variant only.
ana: (typo fixed) ana: Goals for pilot: 1) Deploy to 3 consenting tenants, 2) Auto rollback when quality metric drops >10% vs baseline within 60m window AND min_samples met, 3) CS can manually override, 4) Provide dashboard + alerting. Success metrics: rollback correctly reduces error rate >= 50% within 2h and false positive rollback rate <5%.
matt: Acceptance criteria (engineering): - can ingest per-tenant metric stream - evaluate sliding window checks - trigger rollback API call - expose event log + audit entries.
leah: Suggested acceptance details: - min_samples default 100 - window_mins default 60 - threshold_pct default 10 - ability to set tenant-specific overrides via config API.
matt: Quick config example to implement endpoint for:
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "metric": "response_quality",
  "threshold_pct": 10,
  "window_mins": 60,
  "min_samples": 100
}
```
leah: Edge-case checklist: - slow-moving regressions (detect over 24h) - bursty traffic causing spikes - overlapping rollback requests from multiple monitors - data lag from batch evals.
jordan: CS asks for runbook steps and customer-facing messaging for rollbacks. Also want ability to opt-out per tenant.
nana: (fixed again) ana: Non-functional reqs: logs retained 30 days for pilot, alerts to CS slack channel, telemetry tagged by tenant.
prod-bot: Created ticket RED-PRD-4578 and link https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-PRD-4578 :white_check_mark:
matt: If we accept pilot, I'll scope infra tasks and draft spike tickets for per-tenant eval store.
nana: (finally) ana: Owners: engineering=matt, design=sam, QA=leah, CS=jordan. Please ack and add any missing risks. Target kickoff next Monday. :calendar:
leah: ack.
matt: ack.
sam: ack.
jordan: ack.
